summary: WF International Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting a private placement of 1,680,671 ordinary shares at $1.19 per share (aggregate $2,000,000) under Regulation S, expected to close June 26, 2026. Additionally, it entered into a waiver agreement with placement agents Benchmark and Axiom, paying $80,000 and 20,000 shares to waive a right of first refusal and reducing warrant exercise prices to $1.19. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, or other listed event. No board recommendation or advisor is named for a special-situation event. What to watch: potential dilution from warrant exercises at the reduced price may affect existing shareholders.
